dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent along the Komadugu Gana River, Bursari & Tarmua Local Government Area, Nigeria as of 15 September 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240902NGA, GDACS ID: 1102720** This map illustrates satellite-detected water extent along the Komadugu Gana River in Bursari & Tarmua Local Governments in Yobe State, Nigeria as observed from a Pleiades image acquired on 15 September 2024 at 10:38 local time. Within the cloud free analysed areas of about 120 km², a total of about 40 km² of lands appear to be affected with flood waters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
